the cell fatty acid composition is the main factor that determines the A40926 antibiotic factor composition.

the cell fatty acid composition of Nonomuraeva sp. and consequently the A40926 antibiotic composition can be influenced by branched amino acids and the intermediates or end products of amino acid catabolism.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Nonomuraea is able to use a variety of fatty acids as building blocks for the biosynthesis of the glycopeptide complex A40926, and that branched amino acids play an important role as precursors for the synthesis of branched fatty acids.
Nonomuraea species are versatile bacteria able to adapt their cell fatty acid metabolism to the available substrates in the environment.

the fatty acid composition of cell membranes is an important factor in the production of glycopeptide antibiotics and the production of single complex components can be selectively enhanced by manipulation of the culture medium.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cell fatty acid composition can be manipulated by the addition of branched amino acids to the medium.
the fatty acid composition of Nonomuraesa sp. can be modified by changing the amino acid composition of the fermentation medium.
Nonomuraea fatty acid metabolism and antibiotic production can be controlled by manipulating amino acid metabolism and the composition of the culture medium.
